title: Invoices created before the release are not sent again
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use the production test account, connected to its QuickBooks Online company.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, created on production before the release.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced and sent to QuickBooks on production before the release.
custom_steps: 1. In QuickBooks, open the invoice with work order 1's invoice number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The QuickBooks invoice for customer A is still the one sent before the release: there is no second copy and it was not changed on release day.
